cards.title: The Goblin Chieftain
cards.text: The Warren's boss, with more moves as you asked: charges, a returning spear, war drums, dynamite mice.
cards.why: One clip per phase. Mark the moves that read badly or feel unfair.
cards.details:
Four phases. He chops, charges (and is dazed and open if the charge hits a pillar), and throws a spear that flies back to his hand. From phase 2 war drums call goblins from tunnel mouths and speed him up until they're smashed, and he whistles up dynamite mice. Later a cleaver spin that leaves him dizzy, a bomb barrage, and paired charges at the end.

In tests a level-15 party of three won 4 fights in 10, about 4 minutes each. The fights are long.

He is the orc recoloured for now. The clips were recorded before the balance pass, so the numbers on screen are a little out of date.

cards.title: The Great Ooze
cards.text: The Sewers' boss. It shrinks as it's hurt, and the Thing in the Cistern's tentacles are its third phase.
cards.why: You picked the Great Ooze and liked the Thing without rising water, so the Thing is folded in. Mark what's off.
cards.details:
Four phases. A hop slam that leaves slicks, a spit, a smother. From phase 2 it sheds slimes that crawl home to heal it. In phase 3 tentacles slam out of the canals and drag heroes into the water. In phase 4 it melts: faster, and its hops leave gas.

In tests a level-17 party won 10 fights in 10: too easy now, to be toughened.

cards.title: The Winter Queen
cards.text: Frost Hollow's boss, built as the roster proposed because your answer was "IDK". Keep her?
cards.why: She needed to exist for the dungeon to have a boss, but she is my call, not yours. Say no and I'll design something else.
cards.pick: Keep the Winter Queen as Frost Hollow's boss.
cards.details:
Four phases: ice lances; a frost nova, then she blinks away; a wall of ice through the middle of the party with a spike on whoever is cut off; mirror images that cast and shatter; a blizzard with hail.

In tests a level-41 party won 2 fights in 10 after the balance pass (7 before): too hard, to be eased. She is the Frost Mage's art recoloured for now.

cards.title: Cinder, the Old Drake
cards.text: Ember Deep's boss: a wingless drake in parts. Head, five armoured segments, and a tail you can break.
cards.why: You asked for a wingless drake made of several parts. Mark what's off.
cards.details:
Three phases. The head is the boss; the body segments pass a fifth of each blow through; the tail has its own health and breaking it stuns the drake. Bite; Scorch, a narrow flame cone that turns slowly and stops at pillars; a tail lash; fireballs from the sky that leave burning ground; a coil rush; and a molten body that drips fire.

In tests a level-50 party won 5 fights in 10.

cards.title: The Gilded Seraph
cards.text: A new boss for the Gilded Spire, since the Hollow Saint was a rethink. Keep her?
cards.why: This one is designed from scratch without you, so it needs your yes or no before it gets real art.
cards.pick: Keep the Gilded Seraph as the Spire's boss.
cards.details:
Four phases: three breakable sun blades that circle her and fly at heroes; smite; beams of light that sweep like clock hands; a dive; a choir whose song shields her until it's silenced; and a fall, where her radiance turns to curse.

In tests a level-58 party won 2 fights in 10 after the balance pass: too hard and too long, to be eased.

cards.title: The Sand Wurm
cards.text: The Sunken Dunes' boss, as you asked: it burrows, runs at its mark under the sand, and erupts.
cards.why: Mark what's off. The clips show it on the Spire's floor: they were recorded before the Dunes existed.
cards.details:
Three phases. A head and eight segments that follow it. It dives, a mound with a dug trail runs at its mark, the ground shakes, then it erupts and rears along a line. Phase 2: double eruptions and a tremor ring. Phase 3: a sinkhole that drags the party to the middle.

At the Dunes' own strength a level-62 party won 1 fight in 10: far too hard, to be eased once the last dungeons are balanced.

cards.title: The Great Engine
cards.text: The Clockwork Foundry's boss: a floating head and two hands that attack on their own.
cards.why: Your Skeletron idea. Mark what's off. The clips show it on the Spire's floor: they were recorded before the Foundry existed.
cards.details:
Three phases. The head takes half damage while both hands are up, full with one gone, and half again more with none. A hammer hand and a claw hand act separately, can be broken, and are rebuilt after 12 seconds; breaking a hand as it winds up cancels its blow. Rocket fists, a head spin, a sweeping eye beam, a clap.

At the Foundry's own strength a level-66 party won 0 fights in 10: far too hard, to be eased once the last dungeons are balanced.

cards.title: Two new dungeons
cards.text: The Sunken Dunes and the Clockwork Foundry are in, after the Spire, with the rest of the approved roster.
cards.why: Your roster answers, built. All new enemies are recoloured stand-ins until their art round. Mark what plays wrong.
cards.details:
Left out because you marked them rethink or unsure with no replacement: the Brood Queen, Old Frost as a mini-boss, the magma golem, ash wraith, Dragonborn Champion, Archon, Hollow Saint, golden cobra, scorpion, Tomb Guard, Wurm Mother and Sun Pharaoh.

Known problem: a fully skilled starting trio can't clear the Spire, the Dunes or the Foundry yet. The last three dungeons need their own balance pass.

parts.title: Frost Hollow
parts.text: Frost wolves, ice slimes that leave cold patches, frost spiders, the yeti rolling a snowball you can break, the icicle wraith that drops icicles on a shadow, frost spirits. The ogre is gone.

parts.title: Ember Deep
parts.text: Fire spiders, hellhounds that leave a fire trail and breathe a flame cone, cinder bats that dive and explode, fire spirits. The Pit Lord has a fire whip and rifts that spit imps.

parts.title: Gilded Spire
parts.text: Fallen angels that curse, sun blades that spin through the party, choir sprites whose song heals until staggered, golems, a gilded golem that bounces shots back, and the Twin Heralds as the floor 2 mini-boss.

parts.title: Sunken Dunes
parts.text: Scarabs that burrow and come up beside you, cobras that spit poison, jackal guards that sidestep and counter, mummies that pull you in, sand mages with dust devils, a sand serpent, dart traps on the walls, quicksand.

parts.title: Clockwork Foundry
parts.text: Rolling gears, bomb bots, automatons that overheat after three blows, floor and wall turrets, mortars, tesla coils, repair drones, the smith, bees, wasps and hornets in copper, bronze and steel, a saw blade on the wall, steam vents and conveyors.
